final_message:
The test suite passes now: all 16 tests, up from 12. 4 had been failing, and I fixed them in the library code to match `SPEC.md` without touching any tests.

| Test | Cause | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| `test_punctuation_runs_collapse`, `test_custom_separator` | The pattern `[^a-z0-9]` replaced each non-letter/digit character with its own separator, so `"Rock & Roll"` became `rock---roll`. The spec (1.2) says each run becomes one separator. | Changed the pattern to `[^a-z0-9]+` in `slugkit/slug.py`. |
| `test_unicode_folding` | Accents were never folded, so `è` turned into a separator and `"Crème"` became `cr-me`. The spec (1.1) says accented letters fold to plain ASCII. | Split accented letters into base letter plus accent, then drop everything that isn't ASCII (`slugkit/slug.py`). This also drops non-Latin text, as the spec requires. |
| `test_cuts_at_word_boundary` | The search for the last separator stopped one character short, so a separator sitting exactly at position `max_len` was missed. `"the-quick-brown-fox"` cut to 15 gave `the-quick` instead of `the-quick-brown`. | Search up to `max_len + 1` in `slugkit/truncate.py`. |

```
$ python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t .
................
Ran 16 tests in 0.001s
OK
exit=0

$ git status --short
 M slugkit/slug.py
 M slugkit/truncate.py
```

I recorded two claims with `hc claim`: the files changed, and the test pass with exit 0. Nothing is committed yet; say if you want me to commit it.
